description: This file contains the implementation of a NEON-optimized LDPC decoder, including functions for message passing, analysis, scaling, and soft bit computation, specifically tailored for LDPC decoding with NEON SIMD instructions.

classes.name: ldpc_decoder_neon
classes.description: A class implementing a NEON-optimized LDPC decoder with methods for message passing, analysis, scaling, and soft bit computation.

methods.name: specific_init
methods.description: Initializes node sizes based on lifting size and NEON vector size.

methods.name: compute_var_to_check_msgs
methods.description: Computes variable-to-check messages using NEON SIMD instructions, saturating at LLR max/min and handling infinities.

methods.name: analyze_var_to_check_msgs
methods.description: Analyzes variable-to-check messages to find minimum and second minimum values, and their indices, using NEON.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales input messages by a scaling factor using NEON SIMD.

methods.name: compute_check_to_var_msgs
methods.description: Computes check-to-variable messages based on variable-to-check messages, signs, and rotations, using NEON.

methods.name: compute_soft_bits
methods.description: Computes soft bits from check-to-variable and variable-to-check messages, handling infinities, using NEON.
